en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a bird's‑eye northern view over a historic European city with dense low houses in the foreground and a prominent church with a very tall, slender spire rising above the old town in the background. Printed German text appears around the image, including a greeting from Reval and a caption indicating it is a northward bird's‑eye perspective.
